findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "watch" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Subscribe to a domain: get a signed webhook (X-Desvela-Signature, HMAC-SHA256) when what it publishes for AI agents changes — ai-catalog.json entries added/chan…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: watch · Public sink: preflight, watch, search · Destructive: watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: watch · Public sink: preflight, watch, search · Destructive: watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
